A patient who had relapsed after treatment with melarsoprol and eflornithine given singly was cured when the drugs were given together.6 Ef- lornithine is not effective when given alone in T. b. rhodesiense infections, and early reports of its use with suramin were not en- couraging.7 However, benefit has been reported from use with nifurtimox.8 1.
